description: Let chough session new accept the SpecSync module IDs that init accepts, such as chat.service (review thread 4465229406 on #77)
no_spec_change_rationale: Code-only fix: session new checked --module with the session-key rule instead of the SpecSync module-ID rule that init, checkpoint, bugs, evidence and cases already use (#56); no requirement text names a module-ID rule, so no canonical spec changes
acceptance_criteria: Source: review thread 4465229406 on #77 (Leif's agent): chough session new --module chat.service fails while chough init --module chat.service works. Outcomes: session new accepts every module ID init accepts, such as chat.service and identity-wipe.service, and stores them in the session; module IDs SpecSync refuses, such as a/b, .., a trailing dot or a leading space, are refused with the same invalid module name message as init and no session file written; a failing test comes first; fledge lanes run verify passes

answers.constraints: Reuse records::valid_module_name, the SpecSync 6.1.2 module-ID rule init already uses (#56), rather than a new rule; refuse with nothing written as before; no requirement text changes; no em or en dashes in prose
